subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about scaling paid subscribers for {Brand} the way we have for learning apps like Babbel and Busuu. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the first paid subscription and validate it through App Store Server Notifications V2 and Google Play RTDN, netting out refunds and failed renewals before the event counts, so you pay for renewing payers at a trial-to-paid around 40%. If it helps, I can share the streak-to-renewal cohort view. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate first-paid-subscription validation proof
register_notes: Stage 1 EN education: references prior outreach in S1 (Babbel/Busuu, reused from parent); restates single proof (optimize to first paid subscription + server-side validation netting refunds/failed renewals); one illustrative MobUpps figure (trial-to-paid 40%); soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English-tolerant register; X-not-Y avoided; no em-dash; only brands from parent.
